reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that configures GitHub, Gitea, and npm CLIs and exposes issue-management and npm package-publishing workflows.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 GitHub、Gitea 和 npm CLI 的配置、认证、议题管理及 npm 包发布工具。
summaries.en: Provides DeepSeek Harness tools for configuring and authenticating GitHub, Gitea, and npm CLIs, managing issues, and publishing npm packages.

capabilities: Detects and installs GitHub and Gitea CLI tools
Guides GitHub, Gitea, and npm authentication using environment tokens, browser flows, or manual tokens
Reads masked token environment variables and stores CLI authentication tokens
Lists, views, creates, comments on, closes, and reopens GitHub or Gitea issues
Detects npm status and registry configuration
Publishes npm packages, including dry-run support
